'''R2-Y9''' was an orange and black [[R2-series astromech droid/Legends|R2-series astromech droid]] that served in [[Shadow Squadron/Legends|Shadow Squadron]] as [[Tag (clone trooper pilot)/Legends|Tag's]] [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] in the early stages of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. During the shortcut Shadow Squandron took to counterattack the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] new heavy cruiser the [[Malevolence/Legends|''Malevolence'']]{{'s}} attack on the Kaliida Nebula Medical station, Tag's engine was damaged while trying to dodge Neebray, which reside in the Kaliida Nebula. R2-Y9 was destroyed during the counterattack when Tag's [[BTL-B Y-wing starfighter/Legends|BTL-B Y-wing starfighter's]] engine failed. Tag along with R2-Y9 crashed with that of fellow [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Matchstick/Legends|Matchstick]].
